# Nabda OTP

> The cheapest WhatsApp API for MENA — unlimited messages, REST API, webhooks, from $10/month with no per-message fees.

Nabda OTP is a WhatsApp Business API gateway for developers and businesses in Iraq, Syria, and the broader MENA region. It enables OTP verification, order confirmations, appointment reminders, account security alerts, and marketing messages over WhatsApp. Pricing is flat-rate: a monthly bundle with unlimited messages — no per-message charges, no setup fees, no contracts. Plans start at $10/month and support REST API access, webhooks, and delivery tracking.

Nabda OTP is a focused alternative to per-message WhatsApp providers like Twilio, UltraMsg, and OTPiq — for teams that need high volume and predictable costs, without paying per send.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en): WhatsApp OTP API overview, key statistics (1M+ messages delivered, 2s average delivery, 99.9% uptime, 180+ countries), how it works, feature highlights, pricing plans, FAQ, and payment methods.
- [Pricing](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en#pricing): Flat-rate monthly plans starting at $10/month. Unlimited messages within each plan. No per-message fees. Compare Starter, Growth, and Business tiers.

## Solutions

- [OTP Verification](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en/solutions/otp-verification): Send one-time passwords via WhatsApp for login, signup, and account recovery flows.
- [Order Confirmations](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en/solutions/order-confirmations): Automate order confirmation messages via WhatsApp for e-commerce and delivery businesses.
- [Appointment Reminders](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en/solutions/appointment-reminders): Reduce no-shows by sending automated appointment reminders to customers on WhatsApp.
- [Account Security](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en/solutions/account-security): Protect accounts with two-factor authentication (2FA) messages delivered over WhatsApp.
- [Marketing Messages](https://www.nabdaotp.com/en/solutions/marketing): Send promotional campaigns, offers, and product announcements via WhatsApp Business API.
